rules: This is a static permissions/fixture resolver, not execution evidence or a reduction of the 5280 baseline/1546 manual jobs/135-ID scope.

Role kinds are permission eligibility, not a mandate to multiply all44routes by all9accounts. Distinct rendered role branches and the ROUND dimensions still require measured coverage; redirects cannot stand in for the intended placeholder.

Every all-route placeholder job remains pending until actual direct-load and client-navigation frames and their ready reference are measured. A valid page template does not prove its intended route was loaded.
Coverage is Manager/Owner-only by actual page guard. The source cloud-inventory managerOnly set omits it and must not be treated as authority.

The source cloud-inventory executor imports service/fixture implementations from the tools checkout. Do not run it for exact-source evidence; any adopted fictional fixture definition must bind imports to the released source and record hashes.
Callout canonical query is shiftId, while Swap uses sourceShiftId. Preserve existing manual case IDs; attach canonical resolved URL in evidence when executing inherited placeholder routes.
Combined33 Coverage has no route-specific loading.tsx and inherits Schedule. Retained ST-WA-1 is an observation obligation; no dynamic reproduction is claimed here.
RootLoading uses destination prefix choices; direct-load and client-navigation ancestor frames must be observed rather than inferred from the nearest child loading.tsx.
No preview, browser, seed, application test, CI, app edit, commit or push was performed for this catalog.
